rationale: All 8 findings resolved. CR-006 (critical): response.content list now unwrapped correctly. CR-002/003/005 (major): metadata guard fixed, get_model_details and invoke wrapped in ToolException. CR-004: image content switched to LangChain portable image_url format. CR-007: chat_model instantiated lazily in execute() — get_llm_by_credentials removed from get_tools(), toolkit now passes request_uuid. CR-001: all callers confirmed updated. CR-008: commit amended to EPMCDME-14121. No spec/story provided — no-spec mode; confidence low reflects missing acceptance criteria, not code quality.

standards_review.notes: Commit amended to 'EPMCDME-14121: Inspect image tool now independently calls LLM.' — satisfies required ticket-prefix format.
chat_model: Any | None field removed; all public fields now use explicit types.
No hardcoded credentials, no auth bypass, no injection vectors introduced.

finding_status.notes: All callers confirmed updated to expect plain-text content; response_format: 'content' is intentional.
Fixed: metadata[LLM_MODEL] checked for None before str() conversion; isinstance guard prevents AttributeError on non-dict metadata.
Fixed: llm_service.get_model_details() wrapped in try/except → ToolException; explicit None check on model_details added.
Fixed: HumanMessage image content switched from Anthropic-specific source_type/data schema to portable LangChain image_url format.
Fixed: chat_model.invoke() wrapped in try/except → ToolException; None guard added on response before accessing .content.
Fixed: response.content list unwrapped — text blocks extracted by type, other block types stringified; bare str passthrough preserved.

Fixed: chat_model field removed from InspectWorkspaceImageTool; get_llm_by_credentials now called lazily inside execute(), wrapped in try/except → ToolException. toolkit.py passes request_uuid instead.
Fixed: commit amended to 'EPMCDME-14121: Inspect image tool now independently calls LLM.'
